_handoff.scope: Public first-person accounts relevant to Aadhaar address updates. This is quarantined citizen evidence only: it may surface lived outcomes, failure modes, terminology, and possible recovery paths, but does not establish UIDAI procedure, accepted documents, fees, timing, or a universal outcome. Names, handles, vehicle, property, account and application identifiers, addresses, phone numbers, and identity data are omitted.
limitations: Accounts are self-reported, case-specific, and may be old or changed since publication.
No live Aadhaar login, OTP, upload, payment, submission, booking, status lookup, personal data, or undocumented API was used.

Wayback snapshot capture was attempted for each public page on 2026-09-04, but the archive host was unavailable to this research environment; the original specific URLs and this archival limitation are retained.
The sources do not establish official procedure or current acceptance of a proof document.

sources.title: Aadhaar: Address update procedure and related issues — public forum discussion
sources.notes: Two forum participants reported separate online address-update outcomes: one reported completion after aligning wording with a rental agreement, and one reported a data-mismatch rejection after submitting documents. Location, profile handles, and address details are omitted. Wayback capture was unavailable on access.

sources.title: LPT - This is the easiest way to change Aadhar address — public forum discussion
sources.notes: A now-deleted participant reported uploading a document in the Aadhaar portal and said the address update appeared the following day. Personal, policy, payment, and document-detail information is omitted. Wayback capture was unavailable on access.

sources.title: HoF based address updated rejected — public forum discussion
sources.notes: A participant reported using the online portal's Head of Family route, approving the request in that role, and receiving a relationship/gender-mismatch rejection for one household member. Handles, household relationships, and identity details are omitted. Wayback capture was unavailable on access.

claims.text: One citizen reported that an online Aadhaar address update completed after the entered address wording was aligned with the wording in that person's rental agreement.
claims.notes: One August 2020 account. It does not establish that this wording practice is required, that a rental agreement is currently accepted, or that an online request will complete within the reported time.

claims.text: One citizen reported that an online Aadhaar address-update request was rejected with a data-mismatch message after documents were submitted.
claims.notes: One August 2020 account. The participant's thought about abbreviated address wording is not verified and is retained separately only as a possible lead.

claims.text: The citizen who reported a data-mismatch rejection speculated that differences between abbreviated and expanded address wording might have contributed.
claims.notes: An uncorroborated participant speculation, retained only as a checkable failure-mode lead; it is not a UIDAI requirement or diagnosis.

claims.text: One citizen reported that an address update appeared the day after that person uploaded a document through the Aadhaar portal.
claims.notes: One June 2026 account. It does not establish current processing time, document acceptance, portal behavior, or an official procedure.

claims.text: One citizen reported an online Head of Family address-update request rejected with a relationship/gender-mismatch reason.
claims.notes: One November 2023 household account. It establishes only that reported route and reported result, not the current Head of Family procedure or a general rejection rule.
